The Preconstruction Manager serves as the subject matter expert and primary owner of front-end project planning, cost development, schedule development, constructability, and commercial evaluation through preconstruction. As projects progress toward execution, the Preconstruction Manager partners closely with the assigned Project Manager to establish a well-defined project baseline and transition the project into active construction. The Project Manager remains accountable for overall project delivery, with Procurement retaining ownership of procurement strategy and execution and Project Controls supporting project financial controls and reporting. Key Responsibilities Serve as the lead for front-end planning and preconstruction, owning development of project cost, schedule, constructability, assumptions, and commercial inputs while coordinating closely with the Project Manager and functional teams responsible for procurement, project controls, engineering, and commissioning. Work with the central engineering team to translate design standards and design change decisions into schedule and cost assumptions for future projects, before those decisions are finalized. Build and maintain parametric and scenario-based schedule models (e.g., toggled duration curves by MW size, site condition, and delivery strategy) that can be applied quickly to new opportunities without starting from scratch. Develop and maintain budgetary and conceptual pricing models, including per-MW cost benchmarks, cash flow curve modeling, and escalation assumptions, informed by the organization's historical actuals. Lead or support the RFP process for future projects: scope definition, bid package development, GC and subcontractor solicitation, bid leveling, and award recommendation. Coordinate directly with GC and design partners during the RFP window to validate pricing assumptions, schedule durations, and scope completeness before contract award. Maintain a preconstruction knowledge base (benchmark costs, schedule durations, lessons learned from past RFPs) that improves the speed and accuracy of future estimates. Lead alignment across multiple concurrent preconstruction projects, comparing cost, schedule, and risk between them and aligning implementation and constructability approaches across internal stakeholder teams. Own recurring status, risk, budget, and schedule reporting for projects in preconstruction and planning, including key performance indicators presented to leadership. Support build strategy for new programs, including site diligence review, supply chain analysis, vendor selection, and development of a procurement and contracting roadmap with appropriate teams. Lead and influence stakeholders on high-impact initiatives across delivery, design/engineering, and construction teams to de-risk project delivery, including labor availability, productivity, and competition for talent. Manage a high volume of daily cross-functional interaction with both internal teams and external partners. Provide technical expertise to cross-functional teams on cost, schedule, and commercial accountability topics. Represent preconstruction status and pipeline readiness in recurring leadership and Corporate Development updates. Perform other miscellaneous related duties as assigned. Qualifications 10+ years of experience in preconstruction, estimating, or project controls within commercial construction; data center or mission-critical experience strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience building conceptual/budgetary pricing and schedule models for projects that have not yet reached design completion. Experience running or substantially supporting a formal RFP process, including bid leveling and GC/subcontractor evaluation. Comfort working with incomplete or evolving scope and translating early design intent into defensible cost and schedule ranges. Working knowledge of Procore (or comparable project management platform) and strong Excel/financial modeling skills. Ability to communicate directly with Corporate Development and executive audiences on feasibility and risk, not just with construction teams.

review_candidates.description: Únete a una de las mejores empresas para trabajar en Perú! Somos el ecosistema de soluciones para Trade Marketing con mas experiencia en Latinoamérica. Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de futuros líderes como tú que puedan integrarse a nuestra gran familia en la posición de: GERENTE DE NEGOCIOS / CANAL MÓVILES ¿Qué realizarás? Planeamiento Estratégico Móvil: Diseñar e implementar la hoja de ruta comercial anual para la línea de Móviles (MX), alineando las metas de la marca líder representada con la dinámica comercial de lanzamientos (Unpacked / Flagships), campañas clave y estacionalidades de tecnología. Gestión Basada en Data (Analytics & Sell-out): Monitear y analizar KPIs críticos de movilidad (Market Share / SOM, Inventarios en Operador/Retail, Sell-In vs. Sell-Out, Cobertura y Tasa de Conversión) para identificar brechas de mercado, oportunidades por zonas/planes y mitigar riesgos de sobrestock. Relacionamiento Estratégico con Operadores y Retailers: Gestionar la relación comercial con Jefes de Categoría, Compradores y Product Managers de Operadores (Claro, Movistar, Entel, Bitel) y Cadenas de Retail Especializado, asegurando cuotas de exhibición en cabeceras/experiencia, participación en catálogos de portabilidad y acuerdos promocionales favorables. Liderazgo y Gestión de la Fuerza de Ventas en PDV: Dirigir, motivar y alinear a la estructura de supervisión, trainers y fuerza de promotoría desplegada en Puntos de Venta (PDVs) a nivel nacional, garantizando una ejecución impecable en piso y un speech comercial altamente capacitado. Control Presupuestario y Trade Marketing: Administrar el presupuesto comercial de la cuenta, optimizando el gasto en exhibición, activaciones, co-op marketing, material POP e incentivos para la fuerza de ventas (Sell Out Incentives) para asegurar un ROI positivo. Reporte Ejecutivo de Alto Impacto: Elaborar dashboards periódicos y presentaciones ejecutivas para la alta dirección y la marca líder, respaldando los resultados, la evolución de participaciones de mercado frente a la competencia (Xiaomi, Apple, Honor, Motorola) y proyecciones de cierre. Requisitos: Formación: Licenciado en Administración, Ingeniería Industrial, Marketing, Economía o carreras afines. (Deseable MBA o especialización en Gestión Comercial / Trade Marketing). Experiencia: Mínimo 4 a 5 años liderando áreas de Trade Marketing, Ventas o Gestión Comercial, específicamente en el sector de Telecomunicaciones, Marcas de Smartphones/Tech, o Distribución de Tecnología Móvil. Conocimientos Específicos: o Profundo conocimiento del ecosistema Telco en Perú (Planes postpago, portabilidad, renovación, financiamiento en recibo) y Canal Moderno / Retail. o Manejo avanzado de herramientas de visualización de datos (Power BI, Tableau, Looker). o Excel a nivel experto (modelos de compensación, matrices de variación, tablas dinámicas y análisis financiero). Idiomas: Inglés nivel intermedio/avanzado (deseable para interacción corporativa). ¿Qué ofrecemos? Ingreso a  planilla completa  desde el primer día. Estabilidad laboral  y oportunidad de crecimiento dentro del ecosistema Lucky. Acceso a  formaciones ejecutivas  para potenciar tu liderazgo y gestión comercial. Cultura basada en el  buen humor, la pasión y la honestidad .

review_candidates.title: Integration Consultant (Healthcare)
review_candidates.description: CAPGEMINI ENGINEERING At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where can you make a difference. Where no two days are the same. YOUR ROLE We are looking for an experienced and motivated Integration Consultant to join our team. Your key responsibilities will be: Design, develop, and maintain system integrations across multiple platforms Deliver end-to-end healthcare integration projects, with a focus on reliability and scalability Work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions Develop and implement integration components using various tools and technologies Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues efficiently Ensure adherence to healthcare interoperability standards and best practices Support database design, implementation, and administration activities Continuously improving system performance, data flow, and solution quality YOUR PROFILE University degree or master’s degree in IT, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience). 4–5 years of experience in a similar role (Integration Consultant, Developer, or equivalent). Strong experience in database design, development, and administration (Oracle DBA experience is highly valued). Proven experience delivering end-to-end healthcare integration projects, ideally including radiology workflows. Hands-on Experience Developing Integration Components Using Technologies Such As Mirth Connect JavaScript, .NET, Java/J2EE PL/SQL C / C++ COM object-based interfaces Web services, XML, SOAP Knowledge Of Healthcare Interoperability Standards DICOM HL7 IHE (Integrating Healthcare Enterprise) Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills. Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written in English). What You’ll Love About Working Here Join a multicultural and inclusive team environment. Enjoy a supportive atmosphere promoting work life balance. Full-Remote work. Your career growth is central to our mission. Our array of career growth programs and diverse professionals are crafted to support you in exploring a world of opportunities. Access valuable training and certifications in cutting edge technologies. Engage in exciting national and international projects. Health and life insurance. Referral program with bonuses for talent recommendations. Great office locations. About Capgemini Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organizations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate and grow. With unique end-to-end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market-leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries.
